question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?

WITH city_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as city_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790 
        AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
city_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        cq19.cust_city,
        (cq20.city_sales - cq19.city_sales) * 100.0 / cq19.city_sales as growth_pct
    FROM city_quarter_sales cq19
    JOIN city_quarter_sales cq20 ON cq19.cust_city = cq20.cust_city
    WHERE cq19.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
        AND cq20.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city FROM city_growth WHERE growth_pct >= 20
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        p.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790 
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, p.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_total_sales AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(prod_sales) as total_prod_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        total_prod_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_prod_sales DESC) as sales_percentile
    FROM product_total_sales
),
top_20_percent_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_prod_sales FROM product_ranked WHERE sales_percentile = 1
),
q4_2019_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(prod_sales) as prod_sales_q4_2019
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1772
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
q4_2020_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(prod_sales) as prod_sales_q4_2020
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
q4_2019_city_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(prod_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1772
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
q4_2020_city_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(prod_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        pts.prod_id,
        pts.prod_sales_q4_2019 * 100.0 / cqt.total_sales as share_pct
    FROM q4_2019_totals pts
    JOIN q4_2019_city_totals cqt ON pts.prod_sales_q4_2019 IS NOT NULL
),
product_shares_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        pts.prod_id,
        pts.prod_sales_q4_2020 * 100.0 / cqt.total_sales as share_pct
    FROM q4_2020_totals pts
    JOIN q4_2020_city_totals cqt ON pts.prod_sales_q4_2020 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    t20.prod_id,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ps20.share_pct, 0), 4) as share_2020,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ps19.share_pct, 0), 4) as share_2019,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ps20.share_pct, 0) - COALESCE(ps19.share_pct, 0), 4) as share_change,
    t20.total_prod_sales
FROM top_20_percent_products t20
LEFT JOIN product_shares_2019 ps19 ON t20.prod_id = ps19.prod_id
LEFT JOIN product_shares_2020 ps20 ON t20.prod_id = ps20.prod_id
ORDER BY share_change ASC
